notes: cics-crucible ghost-tasks / gt-assign-startcode (Apache-2.0 corpus, owner OK 2026-10-31 for the ladder, #6072): ASSIGN STARTCODE / USERID / FACILITY / SCRNHT / SCRNWD: how a task was started, the default user, and the terminal facts. Scenarios restate the crucible's terminal steps; the oracle is GnuCOBOL plus the stub, not the crucible's hand-written logs.

scenarios.name: mode-t
scenarios.why: a terminal task: STARTCODE TD, the user, FACILITY T001, 24x80; then three STARTs

scenarios.name: mode-p
scenarios.why: mode P: logs, SEND TEXT, RETURN TRANSID with a COMMAREA

scenarios.name: second-run
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 4 (the RETURN TRANSID's next input): logs P31B and returns

scenarios.name: mode-x
scenarios.why: mode X: START GT34 (no terminal), then SEND TEXT

scenarios.name: mode-other
scenarios.why: a mode no WHEN names: no START, the screen text still goes out
